structured_output.summary: The finding is real. In the hud--first-lap stage at 1440×900, every keycap renders with a 3px border. I confirmed this with a new red test, then added `.ui-keys .ui-keycap { border-width: var(--desktop-outline); }` to keycap-legend.css, and the new test went green. But an existing test, tests/ui/keycap-style.test.ts (from an earlier finding, R3-2), checks that keycaps on that same 1440×900 desktop stage use exactly `var(--outline-default)`, which is 3px. With the fix in place that test fails (612 passed, 1 failed). Tests are append-only, so I'm not allowed to change it. That means the fix can't pass the gates, and the two requirements can't both hold under the rules. I reverted everything: the CSS change and my new test file. The tree is back as it was, and pnpm test passes all 82 files. The owner needs to decide which is right: UI_RULES §3 (4px on desktop) or the R3-2 test (3px). If §3 wins, that test needs to be retired before this fix can land.
